root_cause: The render drive in hypelab/cli.py:_render_job moves queued_render -> rendering (transition() clears the lease), then render() may return {skipped: True} when the output hash already matches. The skip branch returned early with the state untouched, stranding the job in `rendering` with a NULL lease — unclaimable (claim() only reclaims active jobs with a non-NULL expired lease) and unwedgeable without SQL. Audited the other drives: gates has no skip path (_run_gates always routes to ready|gate_failed), so the render hash-skip was the only short-circuit wedge.

summary: Fixed T-005 (BUG-002): the render hash-skip in _render_job returned early, wedging the job in `rendering` with no lease. Restructured so skip and full render share one progression: rendering -> rendered -> queued_gates, exactly like a fresh render. The acceptance message 'hash unchanged, skipping' is preserved verbatim. Skip provenance is sound (render() appends no duplicate manifest entry on skip; the existing renders row already carries the provenance).
